name: current_moment_two_pass

objective.control: Label-only WMSE: mean over the two heads of sum(w*(raw_prediction-z)^2)/sum(w), z=clip(y,-2,2), w=abs(z), on identical fitting mask; zero contribution for total weight <1e-8. No propensity/class/age/episode/auxiliary weighting.
objective.candidate: Minimize the negative mean of the two per-target global_wp_clip2_v1 weighted-Pearson coefficients computed over one current fixed superbatch.
objective.moments: Current superbatch only; unnormalized centered sums for the analytic derivative; no decay, EMA or per-chunk correlation.
objective.gradient_wrt_raw_prediction: For each head: clip_prime(p) * w * [r*(q-mu_p)/Spp - (z-mu_y)/sqrt(Syy*Spp)]; multiply by 1/2 for the two-head mean. If Spp/Syy are normalized by W=sum(w), use w/W.
objective.degenerate_policy: Match scorer: zero contribution when total weight <1e-8 or sqrt(Syy/W) or sqrt(Spp/W) <=1e-8; log counts. Near-constant stability and clipping-boundary subgradient convention are admission gates.
objective.common_row_weight_contract: Same clipped targets z, w=abs(z), fitting masks and row population in both arms. Disable optional propensity, class, since, episode, auxiliary, target-shift and importance weights.

comparison.initialization: Cold per fold/seed; arms share identical initialization within each pair; no teacher, parent or distillation target/cache.
comparison.final_partial_superbatch: Include it; use its actual eligible rows for moments and in both arms.
comparison.state_policy: Carry state across chunks within a sequence; detach at each chunk boundary; reset at sequence boundaries. Candidate replays the same detached boundary states and RNG before one update.
comparison.update_policy: One optimizer update per superbatch; identical grouping, ordering and update count between arms. Exact count is bound with fitting memberships before any fit.
comparison.training_loss_mask: Training membership only: need_prediction plus canonical warm-up handling; no validation labels or masks.
comparison.primary_statistic: D=(1/4)*sum_f mean_s(WP(candidate_f,s)-WP(control_f,s)); equal fold weights, 8/8/7/7 paired seeds.
comparison.uncertainty: Shared CP30 protocol: 10000 seed-bootstrap draws with common seed multiplicities across folds (RNG 20261018), separate paired component bootstrap on fixed predictions, and the two-primary-contrast multiplicity adjustment.

bindings.canonical_model_factory: Reuse project canonical GRU factory; no trainer/model is invented by this proposal.

remaining_work: Implement a focused canonical-GRU adapter for one fixed sequence superbatch; preserve sequence grouping, one-update cadence and K=500 truncation in both arms.

Pass a no-fit synthetic gradient audit: analytical formula versus autograd and finite differences; full-superbatch moments versus same-chunk-truncated direct graph; clip, zero-weight, degenerate/near-constant, mask, reset, detached-state and RNG replay cases.
Bind model/input/LR/optimizer/checkpoint/resume from the exact clean registry; bind source-qualified memberships, data hashes, environment, output paths and clean ancestry.
Profile the implemented paired macrostep on the actual device and account for full-fit time/memory; no profile or cost is claimed.
Obtain separate training authority before any CP30 fit; freeze cells, useful-effect gate, multiplicity and exact command.

commands.plan_only_effect: Prints the expanded paired plan from recipe metadata only; does not access data, allocate devices, fit, infer, profile or score.
